title: Secure Deployments: customer onboarding cadence, release notes coordination, and enablement play for RBAC / Audit / KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinated launch plan to deliver RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integrations for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. This ticket owns cross-functional orchestration (PM + Eng + Design + Security + Support + Sales) for release notes, enablement content, customer onboarding workshops, and compliance artifacts. Goal: enable first wave of enterprise customers to adopt Private features with clear instructions, tested upgrade paths, and audit/KMS guidance to meet customer security requirements.
release_notes_summary: Private deployments: GA of role-based access controls (fine-grained roles + SCIM mapping), persistent audit logging with configurable retention and export hooks, and KMS/HSM integration patterns with key rotation guidance. Includes admin console flows, API samples, and CLI tooling for on-prem installs.
communication_plan: 1) Draft initial release notes (PM) and publish to internal release tracker. 2) Engineering provides detailed upgrade steps and backward-compat notes by 2025-03-22. 3) Legal & Security approve compliance language by 2025-03-28. 4) Customer Success schedules onboarding workshops for committed pilots the week after GA. 5) Marketing publishes public docs and changelog on GA day. Internal playbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-deployments/pm-9912-playbook

acceptance_criteria: Admin console RBAC UI implemented and validated in private staging
Audit logs available with retention config and export endpoint tested
KMS integration documented with sample KMS configuration + rotation guide
Release notes drafted, security copy approved, and support playbook published
At least two pilot customers completed onboarding workshop successfully
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Customers hit upgrade conflicts in air-gapped installs. Mitigation: provide offline upgrade checklist + preflight script (ENG owner: @martin.ng)
Risk: Miscommunication of retention terms for audit logs. Mitigation: legal-approved wording and explicit defaults in docs
Risk: KMS key rotation surprises break encrypted artifacts. Mitigation: include a scheduled rotation test and rollback instructions
